scope: Local bookmark persistence across Discover, Place Detail, and Trips root

contracts.truth_boundary: SavedPlace references canonicalPlaceId without duplicating or mutating canonical places catalog
contracts.display_snapshot: placeName, category, district, imageUrl, rating are cached for offline display only

operations_verified.toggle_save: PlaceDetailScreen / PlaceDetailView toggle bookmark state accurately
operations_verified.idempotent_insert: Saving existing place updates savedAt timestamp without duplicating record
operations_verified.unsave_place: Deleting place removes record cleanly and updates UI reactively
operations_verified.catalog_isolation: Zero mutations to backend/app or canonical datasets
